title: AGENTS Procedure issue-run trigger
description: Agent-submitted trigger files contain only startProcedure and nonce. After initialization, the workflow marks the trigger consumed and writes issue metadata and an initial JSON receipt snapshot.

startProcedure.description: Set true in a new trigger file. The workflow changes it to false after binding and initializing the issue.

nonce.description: Non-negative integer that must match the numeric suffix in the trigger filename.

procedureName.description: Written by the workflow from the filename prefix.

procedureIdentifier.description: The filename stem, such as buildProcedure12.

procedureIssueNumber.description: GitHub issue number created for this trigger.

procedureIssueUrl.description: URL of the issue bound to this trigger.

procedureTitle.description: Canonical title applied by the issue runner after issue creation.

procedureReceiptPath.description: Path to the canonical mutable JSON run receipt under issue-runs/.

procedureSavedHere.description: Snapshot of the initialized receipt when the trigger is consumed. The issue-runs file remains live.

procedureReceipts.description: Ordered receipt snapshots, beginning with the initialized receipt and appended after later issue workflow updates.
